report_name: Chaos Ransomware Claims Attack on Industrial IoT Giant Advantech

threat_actors.name: Chaos
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Advantech. The group employs a double-extortion model involving data exfiltration and encryption.

threat_actors.name: TheGentlemen
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group mentioned in the report for claiming attacks on the French non-profit AGOSPAP and the Spanish firm Auren.

threat_actors.name: INC_RANSOM
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group mentioned in the report for listing the South African systems integrator BCX as a victim.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Chaos ransomware group encrypts files across the victim's network as part of its double-extortion model.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The Chaos ransomware group exfiltrates sensitive data before encryption as part of its double-extortion model.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The Chaos ransomware group likely deletes backups or volume shadow copies to prevent system recovery, a common TTP for this type of actor. The use of 'vssadmin.exe delete shadows' was suggested as a hunting hint.

malware.name: Chaos
malware.description: The ransomware payload used by the Chaos group to encrypt victim systems, often renaming files with a '.chaos' extension.

tools.name: Cobalt Strike
tools.description: A tool typically used by ransomware groups like Chaos for persistence and defense evasion after initial access.

tools.name: wmic.exe
tools.description: The Windows Management Instrumentation Command-line utility, often used by ransomware to disable security products or perform reconnaissance, was listed as a hunting hint.

identities.name: Advantech
identities.description: A major Taiwan-based industrial IoT (IIoT) and embedded computing manufacturer targeted by the Chaos ransomware group.

identities.name: AGOSPAP
identities.description: A French non-profit organization listed as a victim by TheGentlemen group.

identities.name: Auren
identities.description: A Spanish professional services firm listed as a victim by TheGentlemen group.

identities.name: BCX
identities.description: A South African systems integrator listed as a victim by the INC_RANSOM group.

infrastructure.name: Chaos Data Leak Site
infrastructure.description: The public data leak site where the Chaos ransomware group lists its victims and leaks stolen data.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2b8a1c9d-f3e4-4b1a-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware technique to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-30
tags:
  - attack.t1490
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the command line pattern `vssadmin.exe delete shadows`, which is used to prevent system recovery.

tags:
  - attack.t1047
level: medium
logsource:

  product: windows
detection:
  selection:

indicators.name: Ransomware File Extension
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware File Extension Detected
id: 8c7d9e0f-1a2b-4c3d-8e4f-5a6b7c8d9e0f
status: experimental
description: Detects files being created with extensions like .chaos or .locked, indicating potential ransomware activity.
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-30
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.chaos'
      - '.locked'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of files with extensions such as `.chaos` or `.locked`, which is indicative of a ransomware infection.
